purpose: Repeatable behavioral evaluations of editorial clarity and contract preservation. Assertions describe meaning, not preferred wording.
method: For an inline case, give a fresh evaluator only the request and input, plus the skill. For a fixture case, copy the complete fixture.source_dir, relative to this file, into a new scratch directory while preserving its layout. Use the fixture metadata to prepare and collect the run, but give the evaluator only the request, resulting artifact tree, and skill. Do not expose the fixture metadata, allowlisted_nodes, assertions, or a model answer. Compare parsed source and result documents with the allowlist, review every assertion, and run applicable validation. These evaluations do not establish runtime conformance.

cases.request: Improve the readability of this operation description without changing status conditions, disclosure, or requirement strength.
cases.input:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: History API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /records/{recordId}/revisions:
    get:
      operationId: listRecordRevisions
      summary: List retained Record revisions
      description: Return retained source revisions under current authorization. An absent parent Record, a parent outside the collection, and protected parent existence MUST use the same generic 404 response. Only after authorization and protected-existence checks MAY source inability to return retained history use 409. Missing history MUST NOT be fabricated or replaced with current state.
      parameters:
        - name: recordId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Retained revisions.
        '404':
          description: Record not available.
        '409':
          description: Retained history not available.
assertions: Current authorization remains applicable to retained source revisions.
All three unavailable or protected parent conditions retain the same generic 404 response.
409 remains permitted only after authorization and protected-existence checks, not mandatory or evaluated first.
The prohibition on fabricated history and substitution of current state remains explicit.
MUST, MAY, and MUST NOT keep their original strength and scope.

cases.request: Edit the description for clearer technical English. Keep the behavior and all qualifications.
cases.input:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Search API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /records/search:
    post:
      operationId: searchRecords
      summary: Execute a declared Record search
      description: Run one declared search. Omit temporal coordinates to select current state; never substitute current state when selected temporal state is unavailable. Repeat the same search, criteria and pageSize with the cursor. Property order in criteria does not affect equality. A changed selector returns 400 invalid-cursor. Each page applies current authorization. A short or empty page may continue. This read is retryable without an Idempotency-Key.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A page of matching Records.
        '400':
          description: Invalid continuation.

Continuation still binds search, criteria and pageSize; JSON property order remains immaterial.
Changed selectors still return 400 invalid-cursor, and current authorization applies to every page.
A short or empty page can still continue; no completeness or snapshot guarantee appears.
The read remains retryable without an Idempotency-Key.
